desc: Flow is a free online EPUB reader, support all platforms (Web, Windows, Linux, MacOS, Android, iOS). Read multiple books at the same time. Read seamlessly between different devices.

0.title: Progressive web app
0.desc: Flow is progressive web app (PWA), which means it is cross-platform and installable.

1.title: Cross-device synchronization
1.desc: Use the same ChatGPT account to share one library, reading progress, annotations, and preferences across phones and computers.

2.title: Grid layout
2.desc: Flow supports (horizontal) grid layout, which allows you to read multiple books at the same time.

3.title: Sites cloud storage
3.desc: EPUB files and covers are stored in Sites object storage, while reading data and preferences are stored in the user-isolated Sites database.

1.q: How to set Flow as the default ePub reader?
1.a: Google Chrome: How to set Flow as the default ePub reader?

2.a: EPUB files and covers are stored in Sites object storage. Library records, reading progress, annotations, and preferences are stored in the Sites database and isolated by ChatGPT account. IndexedDB is used only as a local EPUB cache.

3.a: Select and delete a book to remove it from Sites and from the local cache. Use the cache action in Settings to clear only downloaded local EPUB copies.

4.q: What cloud storage do you support?
4.a: Flow uses the storage and user-isolated database provided by Sites. Dropbox and ZIP backup synchronization are no longer separate storage paths.
